title: A Line to Sol
text: The dish settles a degree and a half from where it was, and the hub's lights change colour. The beam is ours now: not Sol's line to us but ours to Sol, one way, four years and three months at the speed of light.

lines.text: "Anything we send, Sol hears in four years. Anything it says back, if it ever does, we hear four years after that. It's a letter, not a conversation."
"Then we'd better have something worth putting in it."

choices.label: "Not yet. When we've something to say."
choices.reply: The channel stays open and empty. Ours, when we're ready.

choices.label: Send one line
choices.reply: One packet, in the old format: "Accord 12. Still here." It will be four years old when it arrives.
